Definition: properly, to incline; by implication, to decline (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically, to pitch a tent; gen. to encamp (for abode or siege)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to decline, incline, encamp, bend down, lay siege against; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to decline; 1a2) to encamp
